note: Inert macro expanding to (quote nil): a stray top-level (interactive) is harmless, and inside a defun body it is stripped and instead registers the enclosing defun as a kg command (see internal--has-interactive/internal--strip-interactive, and native-define-command). Emacs' `interactive` is a special form with a rich argument-spec mini-language (code letters, prompts) that supplies a command's arguments from the minibuffer/prefix-arg/region; kg's has none of that yet.
